delivery.read.description: copy the acceptance record of the delivered tree's sdc.delivery case into this case, unchanged; it accepts nothing, and the record keeps its producer, its release revision and the specification revision it ran against. Only while this case holds no acceptance record about the current release revision: a second copy with another result would leave release.accepted unknown for good

release.observe.description: observe the running release; only while no observation of the current release revision is current (younger than its 30 minutes)

release.publish.description: publish and deploy the current release revision; needs a person's approval

release.rollback.description: return to the previous release; needs the same release authority

spec.gate.description: run the ESS gate over the current specification revision; only while no gate run is recorded about it: a second record with another result would leave gate.passed unknown for good

spec.description: the ESS specification; its revision is its spec digest, as in the parent case

gate.checked.description: an ESS gate run is recorded about the current specification revision, whatever its result

gate.passed.description: the ESS gate passes on the current specification revision

release.acceptance_copied.description: an acceptance record about the current release revision, against the current specification revision, is in this case, whatever its result

release.accepted.description: the conformance suite of the current specification passes on the current release

release.healthy.description: the published release is observed healthy within the last 30 minutes

release.observed.description: an observation of the current release revision within the last 30 minutes is recorded, whatever its result

release.published.description: the current release revision is published

rollback.complete.description: a rollback of the current release revision is complete

ess_gate.description: the ESS gate over a specification revision, the four checks run as one program; passed or failed

health_observation.description: an observation of the running release; its result is healthy or unhealthy, and it applies for 30 minutes after it is observed

release_conformance.description: the acceptance run of the delivered tree (`ess verify conform run --target <release> --strict` against a release revision, recorded by sdc.delivery's acceptance.run), copied unchanged; passed, failed or inconclusive

release_record.description: the record that a release revision was published

rollback_result.description: the result of returning to the release before this one; complete or partial

spec.revised.description: an acceptance record observed against an earlier specification revision no longer applies

acceptance.required.description: the delivered tree's acceptance run passed on the release

gate.required.description: the ESS gate passes on the current specification revision

passed.description: the ESS gate passes, and the current release is accepted (the delivered tree's acceptance run), published and observed healthy

rolled_back.description: the release was rolled back completely

protocol.description: Publish and watch a delivered release, run alone from a delivered tree; nothing in the development cycle opens it. Its input is the delivered tree's work (the specification and the release built from the merged changes) and the acceptance record of that tree's sdc.delivery case, copied in unchanged by delivery.read. The ESS gate must pass on the current specification revision; the release is published on a person's approval and observed running. A revised specification sets the copied acceptance record aside. The case ends passed (published and observed healthy), rolled back on a complete rollback result, or withheld on an explicit decision.
